title: validate_submission (MCP tool contract, draft v0.2)
description: v0.2 changes from v0.1 (breaking changes are allowed while the contract is below 1.0): level_id renamed to task_id (level_id still accepted as a deprecated alias); sub-skills and the stage range come from the rubric instead of being fixed; added contract_version, rubric_id, scorable, needs_review; filter flags now have defined effects; confidence semantics defined.

subskill.description: One of rubric.subskill_order for the given rubric_id.

stage.description: 0..rubric.stage_max. null only when output.scorable is false or the grader output could not be parsed.

confidence.description: Grader's self-reported probability that a trained teacher would assign the same stage. UNCALIBRATED until E11 reports a calibration curve; do not use as a routing threshold before then.

evidence_quotes.description: Verbatim spans from submission_text. At least one when stage is not null.

student_id.description: Synthetic (SIM-), adversarial (ADV-), or pseudonymous (STU-). Never a real name or email.

task_id.description: Task / sub-lesson step ID (e.g. C3-L6-T1). Same field name as the event log.

level_id.description: v0.1 name for task_id. Accepted until v1.0.

results.description: Exactly one entry per sub-skill in rubric.subskill_order, in that order.

scorable.description: false when a BLOCKING flag is present; every stage is then null.

needs_review.description: true when a REVIEW flag is present. Stages are still assigned on the evidence, but a teacher should check them before they affect routing beyond the current lesson.

filter_flags.description: BLOCKING (scorable=false, stages null): empty, too_short, gibberish, guardrail_blocked. REVIEW (scored, needs_review=true): prompt_injection, inappropriate, suspected_ai_paste. ERROR (stages null): parse_error. A flag never raises a stage.

cost_usd.description: null when the model's price is not configured.
